title: Range of a Vertically Shifted Parabola
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: With domain all real numbers, find the range of f(x)=x^2+2, i.e. all output values the function actually attains.

steps.title: Bound the Basic Piece
steps.explanation: A square of any real number is never negative, and x^2=0 occurs at x=0.
steps.why: Squaring is the standard source of a lower bound of zero.

steps.title: Shift the Inequality
steps.explanation: Adding 2 to both sides shows every output is at least 2.
steps.why: Adding a constant to a function raises all its values by that amount.

steps.title: Check the Minimum Is Attained
steps.explanation: At x=0 the function equals exactly 2, so the lower endpoint belongs to the range; larger outputs occur as |x| grows without bound.
steps.why: A range endpoint is included only if some input actually produces it.

steps.title: Write the Range
steps.explanation: All values from 2 upward occur, and nothing below 2 does.
steps.why: Continuity of the parabola fills in every value above the minimum.
